title: Independent occurrence observations and replay paths

oneOf.description: Legacy unlinked highlight, accepted for old responses only.

items.$comment: New production always supplies premise_ids and frames. The consumer resolves full EvidenceRef IDs among the same occurrence's statement premises (including before/after point premises), its edge occurrence_id and its exact before/after position premise_id values. Each frame must use that occurrence's exact phase position_id, never a same-FEN substitute, and its squares must be a subset of the highlight's squares. Resource source_ids resolve only in that position's catalogue. Invalid links discard only the highlight, preserving independent observations.

premise_ids.description: Consumed full references beyond the edge and position owners already identified by occurrence_id and frames; those implicit owners need not be repeated.

source_ids.description: Position-local resource hashes; empty for a frame backed only by full premise references.

conditional_evaluations.description: A response search score belongs to the child after the first root action, never to the whole path's first action.

selection_piece.description: A piece witness anchored to this exact position. This is not a fabricated global origin ID.

selection_effects.description: References for complete effect groups included in the comparison text. They do not establish evaluation causality or force a continuation.

attack_ply.description: Optional line_history attack start, counted as the 1-based ply after the actual attacking move. It is later than the comparison anchor and earlier than the full supplied line end. The same physical actor and target are anchored at the comparison; the attack must be its immediate reply or the exact actual-mover use of another independently validated functional effect in this candidate.

evidence_ids.description: Owned occurrence, position and line-proof IDs, and canonical resource source_ids, resolved only within these exact paths and through-ply bounds.

selection_evaluation.$comment: An admitted observation, not independent client authentication of an engine execution. Exact automatic terminal endpoints require a one-move path in the consumer.

inquiry_answer.$comment: The consumer matches both exact root paths and evaluation observations. Work/profile/hash fields retain the server receipt attribution; they cannot authenticate an execution by themselves.

response_answer.$comment: Scores are anchored at the first child, with full-root legal paths linked separately. The consumer checks exact suffix moves and conditional evaluation observations.

response_search.$comment: The consumer verifies the complete legal search scope, exact child path, matched depth, conditional score, and responding-side candidate order. A finite search does not prove a best reply.

proposal_ownership.$comment: Captured on the issued work. The consumer matches work/hash, retained question identities, exact prefix, common reference and bounded pool independently of current answer sufficiency.

pressure_source_ids.description: Exact geometric pressure sources at the root and child positions. May be empty only when the same tracked target has an owned legal en-passant capture in the child position.

proposal_answer.$comment: The existing paired-answer fields apply at the requirement's exact historical prefix. A child answer uses conditional evaluation observations at that prefix, never root evaluation ownership.

fact_result.$comment: The backend owns predicate truth. The receiver validates owned exact paths, position ranges, source references and compatible proof bindings; missing evidence never implies refutation.

proposal_entry.$comment: Generated presentation text does not replace the validated requirements and their owned readings.

proof_moves.description: Exact proof and replay references owned by the selected typed content; only the useful subset needs inline notation.

action_moves.description: Actual actions selected by the typed answer. A linked position-only proof does not activate an unrelated capture or check.

selection_comparison_detail.description: Material relation compares captured-role counts by losing side and promotion-role counts in the exact finite paths, not physical victim identity or event order. Equal and different are both known results within this scope; neither establishes a unique evaluation cause or a forced continuation.

selection_pv_comparison_detail.description: Differences in bounded observed facets, not a forced result, evaluation cause, or complete explanation.

selection_question_comparison_detail.$comment: Every question ref resolves to a compare_moves reading for this exact oriented pair. An empty prefix compares moves at the observed root position. The consumer checks matching owned answers, the turn at the comparison position, paths and selected scene membership without duplicating the answer.

selection_candidate.$comment: The runtime consumer additionally resolves every consumed ID in this response and requires root_occurrence_id in occurrence_ids. missing_line_ids identifies requirements, not consumed evidence. A displayed representative does not erase an exact candidate. Invalid selection data cannot erase existing independent observations.

detail.description: Moves, observed events and the complete material ledger remain in the referenced existing path; they are not duplicated here.

commentary_selection.description: Shared candidates precede display representative selection. Scenes are exact comparison bundles, not a claim that every move is a key scene. Domain-specific readings retain their evidence and availability without a shared explanation-completeness state.

inquiries.$comment: At most two legal-root pools: original reference and one refreshed reference.

statement.$comment: The repository validator supports propertyNames and $defs, but not unevaluatedProperties. Variant propertyNames closes the union while common fields are validated once.
